items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR (BLS-CPR) within 30 days
Previous experience in a medically oriented area

As our Physical Therapy Aide, you will play a vital role in our clinical support team at Pacific Central Coast Health Centers. You will work under the direct supervision of licensed Physical or Occupational Therapists to provide high-quality patient care, ensuring a clean, organized, and safe environment for treatment. By assisting with patient-related activities, clerical tasks, and clinical documentation, you will help maintain optimal department flow and contribute to the overall success of our rehabilitation services.

Every day you will greet and escort patients, prepare treatment areas, and manage supply inventory to ensure readiness for daily procedures. Your responsibilities include assisting with patient treatment plans, educating patients and their families on functional activities, and accurately documenting treatment progress. You will act as a collaborative member of the healthcare team, communicating effectively with staff and maintaining rigorous standards of infection control, safety, and professional ethics to support our mission of excellence in patient care.

To be successful in this role, you will need strong interpersonal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented medical environment. We are looking for an organized professional who can manage priorities efficiently while performing physical tasks, including heavy lifting and assisting with patient mobility. Candidates with previous experience in a medically oriented setting are preferred, and you must obtain your Basic Life Support (BLS-CPR) certification within 30 days of hire to join our dedicated team.
